What every KubeJS script of the pack registers, sets and reads, and where it sits in the load order: read from
the code of `.minecraft/kubejs`, not from headers. How to write a script: `.minecraft/kubejs/README.md`.
How this file is made and checked: `.minecraft/dev/catalogue/README.md`.

| Script type | Scripts | Registrations | Sections | Features |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| startup | 24 | 23 | 26 | 2 |
| server | 160 | 317 | 238 | 19 |
| client | 13 | 8 | 0 | 0 |

The counts are those of the canonical tree. Not in every distribution: `server:validate_recipe_removals.js` (not in server_distribution/kubejs, distribution/client/kubejs), `client:attribute_tooltips.js` (not in server_distribution/kubejs). The registrations the
dedicated server makes are the liveness manifest's (`[icraft.live] ARMED server: 316`, `startup: 23`).

## How to read it

- **Load order.** The engine walks a script folder in the order the file system lists it and then sorts by the
  `// priority` line only (highest first, equal priorities stay in listing order). NTFS lists names upper-cased,
  so letters sort before `_`: `zzz_x.js` loads before `zz_x.js`, `lootjs_overhaul.js` before `loot_overhaul.js`,
  the folder `affixes/` before `affix_x.js`. The places below are computed with that rule
  (`load_order.js --order server`), and `load_order.js --compare-log <kubejs/server.log>` holds them to a real boot.
- **Handler order.** The handlers of one event run in the order they were registered: load order, then source
  order inside a script. A handler registered for a target (`ItemEvents.rightClicked('minecraft:stick', ..)`)
  runs BEFORE the untargeted handlers when that target fires. Both were asked of the engine on a real server.
- **when** a script reads a global: `load` = while the script loads (the script that sets it must load first: an
  order constraint), `handler` = later, inside a handler or a tick (no order needed), `test` = only `typeof`.
- A registration is named as its liveness id names it: `<name>@<group>` is what `[icraft.live] FIRED` prints.

## Order constraints

Every order between two scripts that the code proves or a header declares: 243. 236 are structural (the script that must load first has the higher priority: the guard and the libraries); 7 hold only because of the file names and are declared with `// @after` in the script that needs them. `load_order.js` fails when one is broken.

| Script | must load after | Because | Held by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bonfire/boss_bonfire_system.js` | `bonfire/boss_arena_registry.js` | it reads `global.ICRAFT_BOSS_ARENAS` while it loads (proven by the code) | file names, `@after` |
| `bonfire/boss_compass_handler.js` | `bonfire/boss_arena_registry.js` | it reads `global.ICRAFT_BOSS_ARENAS` while it loads (proven by the code) | file names, `@after` |
| `loot/zz_iss_arena_enrichment.js` | `loot/lootjs_overhaul.js` | handler order on `LootJS.modifiers`: the ISS strip of that file removes what is added before it (LootJS removals apply in registration order) (declared by hand) | file names, `@after` |
| `loot/zz_pack_enchanted_books.js` | `loot/loot_overhaul.js` | handler order on `LootJS.modifiers`: the enchanted-book strip of that file removes what is added before it (LootJS removals apply in registration order) (declared by hand) | file names, `@after` |
| `loot/zz_pack_enchanted_books.js` | `loot/lootjs_overhaul.js` | global.ICRAFT_MARQUEE_BOOKS (set and read in handlers of LootJS.modifiers) (proven by the code) | file names, `@after` |
| `scaling/zz_ascension_scaling.js` | `scaling/boss_hp.js` | handler order on `EntityEvents.spawned`: boss_hp works out its ratio from the maximum health at spawn: the ascension multiplier must not be on the mob yet (declared by hand) | file names, `@after` |
| `scaling/zz_boss_global_3x.js` | `scaling/boss_hp.js` | handler order on `EntityEvents.spawned`: boss_hp works out its ratio from the maximum health at spawn: the x3 must not be on the boss yet (declared by hand) | file names, `@after` |
